description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Iron League Steed, adding {C}{C}.
When Iron League Steed dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Iron League Steed from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Iron League Steed enters the battlefield, its fabricate ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
